inputs.original_text: Wake up and see through the elaborate smoke and mirrors they are using to blind the public. The official story of division and disappointment between the United States and China over the Paris Agreement is a completely staged theatrical performance designed for the masses. When they feed the public stories about the US withdrawing from the treaty for the second time under the Donald Trump administration, it is nothing more than a strategic maneuver to shift pieces on the board and advance the globalist agenda under a false flag of disagreement. The hidden elites are orchestrating these manufactured exits and supposed conflicts precisely to tighten their grip while concealing their real objectives away from public scrutiny.
